text.p: The stock of fashion designer Donna Karan International Inc. lost more than 20 percent of its value Tuesday, one day after the company warned that it would report flat fourth-quarter earnings.
Donna Karan's shares, which were launched in a public offering in June, were off $3.125 at $15.625 in early trading on the New York Stock Exchange.
Several analysts, including Morgan Stanley, also cut their 1996 and 1997 earnings estimates for the company.

Late on Monday, New York-based Donna Karan said it earned $13.0 million, or 61 cents a share, in the third quarter, up from year-ago earnings of $11.8 million, or 52 cents. Sales rose to $173.4 million from $152.3 million.

The company forecast break-even fourth-quarter results because current projections for sales in its beauty division continue to be below target and the unit is expected to report a loss of $900,000 for the quarter.

Donna Karan launched a public offering of 10.75 million shares on June 28, in its second try to go public. The first attempt in 1993 was called off because a drop in sales depressed its offering price.
